The Subtask Name: Identify the smaller astronaut in the January 21, 2006 NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day
Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: Alan Bean
Evidence: The expert searched for the specific APOD image, identified it as featuring Apollo 12 astronauts Charles Conrad and Alan Bean, and determined Alan Bean was the smaller astronaut based on the self-portrait context.

The Subtask Name: Determine the NASA Astronaut Group affiliation of the smaller astronaut
Step Range: 3-4
The Oracle: NASA Astronaut Group 3
Evidence: The expert searched for Alan Bean's astronaut group and confirmed he was part of NASA Astronaut Group 3, selected in 1963.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve time spent in space for all astronauts in NASA Astronaut Group 3
Step Range: 5-10
The Oracle: List of astronauts with flight hours
Evidence: The expert attempted to scrape Wikipedia (failed due to 403 error) and then manually listed the astronauts in Group 3 along with their respective time in space (e.g., Buzz Aldrin 289h, William Anders 147h, etc.), excluding those who did not fly.

The Subtask Name: Calculate the minimum time in space in minutes and format the final answer
Step Range: 10-16
The Oracle: Schweickart;14460
Evidence: The expert identified Russell L. Schweickart as having the least time (241 hours) among those who flew, converted 241 hours to 14,460 minutes, and provided the final formatted answer.
